Method of Attack: Exploiting PaperCut remote-code execution vulnerability CVE-2023-27350 to gain initial access
Bypassing user authentication to access servers as administrators
Spawning cmd.exe and powershell.exe processes with high privileges for remote access and lateral movement
Data exfiltration and encryption of victim systems with ransom notes demanding payment
Attack Vector: Exploitation of internet-exposed vulnerable PaperCut servers with CVE-2023-27350
Indicators of Compromise: Internet-exposed PaperCut servers vulnerable to CVE-2023-27350
Spawned cmd.exe and powershell.exe processes with high privileges
Ransom notes demanding payment for decryptor and data non-disclosure
